name: ug-tax-overview
description: Overview of the Uganda tax system for tax year 2026-27: the year of income, the Uganda Revenue Authority, main taxes, headline rates and filing rhythm, and the changes from 1 July 2026. Use for Uganda questions from URA taxpayers, employers, advisers and foreign investors, including rates, thresholds, filing dates, the URA portal and worked computations. Figures for tax year 2026-27 come from Uganda Revenue Authority pages and the law, and items that could not be opened are named as unverified in the Sources section. Not reviewed by a licensed accountant.
